The Commission by order dated 17.1.2017 had approved the annual fixed charges of generating station from 5.3.2011 to 31.3.2014, as under: 3. It is noticed that in the order dated 17.1.2017, certain inadvertent clerical errors have occurred in the opening equity as on 21.4.2012, opening gross loan as on 21.4.2012, opening gross block as on 21.4.2012 and interest on working capital. 4.
